svg.title: Agnes Harness — One execution foundation for field delivery and the physical world
svg.desc: Animated AGH architecture. LLM is the brain, Jev the cerebellum, Harness the memory and MHS the body; Jev and MHS are planned, and MHS device adapters build on MCP. Clients reach the App Server, the Agent Runtime runs the agent loop with Harness memory and controlled execution, plugins extend the runtime, and the same foundation serves enterprise FDE delivery and future physical-world integration.

g.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, Segoe UI, PingFang SC, Microsoft YaHei, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: One execution foundation for field delivery and the physical world
Shared sessions · task submission · event streaming · approval routing
Host assembles capabilities; Core advances each task inside the worker
Tool approvals · command sandbox · execution policy · recovery
Everything as plug-ins: package trust, dependencies and lifecycle
Compose plugins into a customer-specific agent
Connectors are built and validated per site
Illustrative devices · interlocks and e-stops stay on devices
FDE is a delivery approach. MHS is a device integration direction. Both run on the same foundation.
